title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Meter Error Refunds: Charge Lines Refunded by Rate Schedule
content:
Which daily charge lines of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment enter a meter error refund depends on what the underlying rate schedule bills, as its Electric Service by Rate Schedule schedule figures show: its sales tax percentage and whether the power cost adjustment applies to it.

**Rule.** Where the underlying rate schedule bills sales tax and the power cost adjustment, the refunded lines total is the energy, power cost adjustment and sales tax lines in the refund window; where it bills the power cost adjustment but no sales tax, the refunded lines total is the energy and power cost adjustment lines in the refund window; a schedule in any other situation keeps the energy lines alone.

A schedule bills sales tax when its sales tax percentage is above zero. A window of a stated number of months takes the daily charge lines dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

| Sales tax percentage above zero | Power cost adjustment billed | Lines in the refunded lines total |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | energy, power cost adjustment and sales tax |
| no | yes | energy and power cost adjustment |
| yes | no | energy alone |
| no | no | energy alone |

Hypothetical window: energy lines 300.00, power cost adjustment lines 24.00, sales tax lines 16.20. Taxed schedule with the power cost adjustment: 340.20. Untaxed schedule with the power cost adjustment: 324.00. Taxed schedule without the power cost adjustment: 300.00.
